_comment: The advance/door price register, as ONE set of cases read by both
The two are hand-written twins with no compiler between them, and they
already drifted once: the Go side shipped rendering every amount as whole
dollars, so $12.50 read as '$12' and a fifty-cent door as '$0' — free, in a
subscriber's calendar. Prose cross-references did not catch that. This file
does, because a change to either side that is not made to the other fails a
test rather than reaching a reader.
Add a case here, not to one suite. `advance` and `door` are null for an
unrecorded price; `text` is what a dense list renders, empty for nothing.

cases.name: a cheaper door keeps advance first
a free advance with a paid door keeps both
a sub-dollar price is not free
a fractional pair keeps both spellings
